title: Alive or Not Alive?
retry: Listen once more and choose a pile.

items.text: A fox walks between the trees.
items.note: A fox breathes, eats and grows.
A squirrel eats nuts and grows.

items.text: An owl sits on a branch.
items.note: An owl breathes even when it sits still.
A deer eats plants to help its body grow.

items.text: A rabbit hops under a bush.
A bear drinks from a stream.
items.note: A bear needs food and water.

items.text: A raccoon washes food in a puddle.
items.note: A raccoon is an animal with a living body.
A hedgehog eats small animals and grows.

items.text: A rock rests beside a tree.
items.note: A rock has no living body.

items.text: A plastic fox sits on a shelf.
items.note: A toy fox does not eat or grow.

items.text: A metal fence stands beside the woods.
items.note: People made the fence from metal.

items.text: A glass marble rolls down a hill.
items.note: Rolling does not make a marble alive.

items.text: A wooden bench stands by the path.
items.note: The wood in a bench is no longer a living tree.

items.text: A bear sleeps in its den.
A robot owl turns its head.
items.note: A motor moves the toy owl.

items.text: A tree stands still all day.
items.note: A tree takes in water and grows.

items.text: A dead leaf blows across the path.
items.note: Wind moves the leaf that is no longer alive.

items.text: A stuffed rabbit has soft fur.
items.note: The stuffing cannot breathe or grow.
